message: bridge-deduction-a-wrong (DRAFT outline): wrong calls, escalation, KO and a missed guilty, on test_social_deduction_a. Steps A1-A7 of the -wrong script in §9.2. KOs use debugKO (logged as such); the first-punch warning is checked through a real punch on a calm suspect first.
A1 punch Venn once, then KO her

fn:
async () => { /* A1 one punch on calm Venn: the one-time warning toast, and koWarned records her (the punch key is the T packet's to confirm) */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const r = window.__ded.rt();
  return window.__ded.toastsMatching('Knocking out a suspect counts as accusing them').length === 1 && r.state.koWarned.includes('ded_a_venn'); }

message: A2 the cloakroom: the coats grant nothing now
A2 the T packet picks the cloakroom lock here

fn:
async () => { /* A2 coats taken, no fact granted (the triggers read !a_lodge_suspicious), and the triggers are not marked fired */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const g = window.__ded.g(); const inv = window.__test.getState().inventory.map(i => i.name);
  return inv.includes("Venn's Coat") && !g.se_intel_a_venn_ward_charm && !g.se_intel_a_ishikawa_ward_charm && !(g.scenario_triggers_fired || {}).t_a_coat_venn; }

message: A3 accuse Delacroix: the second wrong call brings the doorman

fn:
async () => { /* A3 wrongCount 2, escalation e:2 ran once, the doorman visible and hostile in the hall */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const r = window.__ded.rt();
  return r.state.wrongCount === 2 && r.state.ran.includes('e:2') && window.npcHostileSystem.isNPCHostile('ded_a_doorman'); }

message: A4 accuse Ishikawa: the third wrong call; HaX rings with the warned get-out; choose Not yet

fn: async () => { /* leave HaX */ const ok = await window.__ded.pick("^That's all for now"); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); if (window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame) await window.__test.minigame.close(); return ok; }

message: A5 KO Okafor in the hall: right call, the key drops, picking it up grants the key fact, HaX's choice call does not open

fn: async () => { /* A5 ko verdict, right_guilty */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const g = window.__ded.g(); const r = window.__ded.rt(); return r.state.verdicts.ded_a_okafor.kind === 'ko' && g.deduction_outcome_ded_a_okafor === 'right_guilty' && window.__ded.toastsMatching('Right call').length === 1; }

async () => { /* A5 the pickup grants the key fact through t_a_key_drop; no phone chat opens (the mapping's condition reads the verdict) */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const g = window.__ded.g(); const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame;
  return g.se_intel_a_okafor_brass_key === true && (g.scenario_triggers_fired || {}).t_a_key_drop === true && !(mg && mg.constructor && mg.constructor.name === 'PhoneChatMinigame') && g.a_key_choice === ''; }
() => { window.__preReload = true; setTimeout(() => location.assign(location.pathname + "?skip_resume=1"), 50); return true; }

async () => { /* A6 reload: verdicts, the doorman (visible, hostile) and Venn's absence all hold */ const r = window.__ded.rt(); const g = window.__ded.g(); const venn = window.npcBehaviorManager && window.npcBehaviorManager.getBehavior('ded_a_venn');
  return Object.keys(r.state.verdicts).length === 4 && r.state.wrongCount === 3 && window.npcHostileSystem.isNPCHostile('ded_a_doorman') && g.ded_a_ally_lost === true && (!venn || venn.visible === false); }

message: A7 close through HaX's Go in without naming Marsh

fn:
async () => { /* A7 entering the sanctum resolves the deferred foe: the acolyte visible and hostile with its health bar; pendingHostiles empty */ const end = Date.now() + 10000; while (Date.now() < end && !window.npcHostileSystem.isNPCHostile('ded_a_acolyte')) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
  return window.npcHostileSystem.isNPCHostile('ded_a_acolyte') && window.__ded.rt().state.pendingHostiles.length === 0 && !!document.querySelector('[data-npc-health="ded_a_acolyte"], .npc-health-bar'); }
